name: universal-desktop-bridge
description: UDB: one public MCP entry point for 60 operations, ConPTY, durable work recovery and a virtual AI pointer.

interface.longDescription: One public MCP tool named udb exposes a discoverable catalog of 60 operations through action=list and action=call. Includes a Win32-message AI pointer, Windows ConPTY terminals, durable work recovery, file and Office jobs. Existing owner permissions are retained. App compatibility varies; unknown writes and dead terminal processes are never replayed.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the single udb tool. Call action=list to discover operations and schemas, then action=call with the selected operation name and its arguments. Check connection and verify the result before reporting completion.
